public_rationale: January 2024 research supports the ordinary behavioral reading. It reports fluent explanations that become inconsistent across related inputs, and high-quality images that mishandle objects and spatial relationships. Together these support the contrast between convincing output and unreliable consistency. The evidence does not prove an absence of internal world understanding. Reported improvements also rule out treating the claim as saying that systems cannot reason or improve.
limitations: Support is qualitative and depends on the stated behavioral interpretation.
The evidence consists of research preprints with limited model and task coverage.
These studies do not independently establish the surrounding post's causal explanation of hallucinations or near-plagiarism.

public_payload.normalized_proposition: Current systems are good at local coherence, both between words and between pixels, but are not good at lining up their outputs with a global comprehension of the world.

statement.excerpt: What unifies all of the above is that current systems are good at local coherence, between words, and between pixels, but not at lining up their outputs with a global comprehension of the world.

from_speaker: not at lining up their outputs with a global comprehension of the world
our_interpretation: The ordinary reading is a contrast between convincing surface output and unreliable consistency with facts, relationships, and whole prompts.
This describes a general weakness, not a claim that every model fails every task or has no useful world knowledge.
Because no reporting period is specified, the target is January 2024 through the post date, the latest reporting window for the ongoing state described.
Fluent language and high-quality visual rendering are proxies for local coherence. Factual, explanatory, and spatial consistency are behavioral proxies for aligning outputs with the world.
These behavioral tests do not establish whether a model possesses an internal global comprehension of the world.
criteria.support_condition: Contemporary research reports convincing language and visual output alongside recurring failures to maintain factual, explanatory, or compositional consistency across the outputs of then-current systems.
criteria.contradiction_condition: Broad evaluations of then-current text and image systems show reliable factual and compositional consistency across varied tasks, undermining the claimed general contrast with surface quality.
